content_sections.heading: GEU Hostel Superintendent (Girls) Job Description
content_sections.text: Manage the overall day-to-day operations of the Girls Hostel. Supervise and coordinate the hostel support staff and ensure effective team management. Maintain discipline, safety, cleanliness, and a conducive living environment for students. Handle student-related concerns and ensure timely resolution of issues. Coordinate with security, housekeeping, maintenance, and other support teams. Ensure compliance with hostel rules, policies, and University guidelines. Maintain proper records, documentation, and reporting related to hostel operations. Handle emergencies and coordinate appropriate action when required.
